verify.title: Google One
verify.subtitle: Get a 1-year Pro trial link
verify.noticeBody: Only submit information needed for this task. Passwords and 2FA secrets are never shown in history.
verify.previewHint: For testing the top ring and task-state motion only. No points are deducted and nothing is written to history.
verify.previewRunningDetail: Running · Simulating the login and claim flow
verify.previewFailureDetail: Simulated execution failed · Please check the account or 2FA configuration
verify.placeholder: Fill in the Gmail address, password, and Base32 2FA secret, then submit
verify.formatHint: Single-account submission is enabled. You can choose the standard queue or the high priority queue.
verify.pendingBackgroundContinue: This task is taking longer than usual and is still being processed in the background. Check task history later.
verify.pendingBackgroundContinueHint: This page will keep syncing automatically; you can also refresh it to continue tracking the current task.
verify.missingRequired: Please fill in the email, password, and 2FA secret
verify.timeout: Job timed out, please retry later
verify.guideCardSubtitle: Prepare the account environment first to reduce failures and risk controls.
verify.guide2faBodyPrefix: It must be enabled. If not,
verify.guideRegionBodyPrefix: The account must be in a supported region. You can
verify.guideFamilyBody: Ensure the account does not already have any other active Pro subscription.
verify.guideAccountBody: Older accounts are strongly recommended. New accounts are far more likely to hit risk control and lose login access. That is an account issue, not a verification issue.
verify.guideNoteBrowser: The browser must already be signed in to this Google account during redemption. If you get an error, switch to another node.
verify.guideNoteRegion: A student status is not required. Any account in a supported region can subscribe as long as you follow the steps.
verify.guideNotePrivacy: We do not store your account information. Submitted data is used only temporarily for the subscription flow and is automatically destroyed afterward. For safety, change the 2FA code after completion, but avoid changing the password immediately to reduce risk-control triggers.
verify.guideNoteSuccessPrefix: After success: open the link and bind your card to subscribe. If you do not have a card, visit the
verify.instruction1: Fill in the Gmail address, password, and Base32 2FA secret in order. One account per submission.
verify.instruction2: Enable high priority if you want faster queueing; otherwise the task enters the standard queue.
verify.instruction3: Provide the Base32 TOTP secret from your authenticator setup, not the current 6-digit code.
verify.instruction4: Only the email and outcome are stored. Passwords and 2FA secrets are not shown in history. SSO domain accounts are not supported.
verify.quotaExhausted: API balance is exhausted. Please contact the admin.
verify.fullQuotaExhausted: The remaining API balance is below 1.0, so a full-flow task cannot be submitted yet.
verify.extractQuotaExhausted: The remaining API balance is below 0.5, so an extract-only task cannot be submitted yet.
verify.fullQuotaSuggestExtract: The current balance is enough for extract-only tasks but not for full-flow tasks. Switch to extract-only to continue.
verify.invalidAccountLine: Please fill in the Gmail address, password, and 2FA secret
verify.invalidTotp: The 2FA secret must be Base32 and may only contain A-Z and 2-7
